rules: Commit the complete active WIP using the user probe exclusion; do not rebase or check out the active source tree during a build.
Publisher borrows active Git objects, so new active commits are visible without another source/history fetch.
In publisher, fetch depth1 origin work, restore only provably cached shallow boundaries, fetch individual missing commit parents depth1 only if required. Never unshallow.
Fast-forward publisher work onto origin/work, then cherry-pick every unpublished active WIP commit in order. Resolve conflicts in publisher without changing active build files.
Before pushing, fetch depth1 work and rebase publisher work onto it. Push only HEAD:work. Never force push or create a PR.

Record source/published commit mapping and diff both trees excluding docs/work/name-handling. Any product divergence must remain explicit and be integrated into active source only between build windows.

After a stable build window, checkpoint all active work and rebase active work onto latest work, allowing Git to skip previously cherry-picked equivalents. Notify owners/rebuild if product inputs changed.
Keep active logs under /tmp; preserve all target/executable disk rules.
source_lineage_note: Active a1dd mapped to ec80 by isolated publisher cherry-pick after depth1 fetch/FF, then fresh depth1 fetch/rebase and normal push. Latest7 external lint product/test files remain published but await active source integration between R1/C6 builds.
